name: What is the process for getting my sliding door screen repaired?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting my sliding door screen repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with you contacting us to schedule an appointment. A technician will visit your property to inspect the sliding door screen, assess the damage, and discuss your repair options and material choices. We'll then provide you with a detailed, transparent estimate. Once approved, we will either perform the repair on-site or, if necessary, take the screen frame to our workshop for rescreening. We'll then reinstall the repaired screen and ensure proper function before completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves scheduling an appointment, on-site assessment and estimate, repair (on-site or off-site), and reinstallation.
